shapes.html: The function run lifts single-step behaviour to a sequence of reactions.
With one input consumed per iteration, the lifting gives the Mealy-machine behaviour of f and initial state st.
We can define composition through single-step components and justify its behaviour through run.

notes: This is the same sequence viewed as a recurring process. Each reaction uses the current input and state and produces an output and the next state. Explain Mealy machine in these concrete terms.
The state is carried from one logical reaction to the next. Explain the source state/delay representation. Folding does not remove state or imply combinational feedback.

For the one-input-per-iteration construction considered here, the lifting yields the expected Mealy-machine behaviour. The thesis uniqueness result is conditional on that iteration discipline; the type alone does not impose it. See Proposition 3.1 and Remark 3.1.

This lets us define composition at the single-step level, and justify the resulting behaviour through run. We do not have to inspect each component internal implementation to establish this composition structure. Functional behaviour still needs a function or behavioural specification, not only its bare interface type. Next: sequential composition, pass-through and parallel composition.
